sources.snippet: WildFeedback significantly enhances model alignment with in-situ user feedback. As detailed in Section section 4, the WildFeedback test set is sourced from real human-ChatGPT conversations where users explicitly express dissatisfaction, implicitly suggesting that the models are poorly aligned with real user preferences on these tasks.
